road_width.origin: User requirement: bus must drive from Washington; only stations remain in road configuration.
retained: all attached station pads, brackets, fasteners and fittings
removed: roof deck and removable roof frame
exclusions: OEM rear-vision mirrors under the statutory exception; no assumed exemption for added structure
road_width.acceptance: Maximum outside width of the complete retained inventory must be at or below 102 inches, including installation and movement allowances. Field dimensions and structural suitability require separate verification.
